title: Fysik A (stx): Kvant21 – quantum physics and quantum technology in 'Fysik i det 21. århundrede'
note: Required on stx Fysik A at all 144 stx schools (Danish Quantum Academy). Kvant21 develops the material for the 3.g topic 'Fysik i det 21. århundrede' (about 15 lessons): two-state systems such as polarised light, the Mach-Zehnder interferometer, single-photon experiments and simulations, and an introduction to quantum cryptography, quantum sensors and quantum computers. Material under development 2025–2027; first teacher courses spring 2027.

title: Fysik A (htx): Kvant21 as supplementary material (optional)
note: Optional at the 34 htx schools: Kvant21 material can be used as supplementary reading or a project in Fysik A. Quantum technology is not on the central list of chosen topics for htx Fysik A in 2026/27.

title: Fysik A (stx): core content in quantum physics (photons, spectra, atomic structure)
note: Core content of stx Fysik A at all 144 stx schools and the basis of the written exam: atomic and nuclear structure, photon energy and momentum, emission and absorption spectra.

title: Fysik A (htx): core content in atomic physics (photons, hydrogen spectrum)
note: Core content of htx Fysik A at all 34 htx schools: photon energy and the hydrogen spectrum explained with Bohr's model of quantised energy levels.
